news.title: Stellarin Research and Development Private Limted agreed to acquire an unknown minority stake in H2o Dynamics India Limited from Quest Flow Controls Limited (BSE:543982) for INR 73.5 million.
news.body:
Stellarin Research and Development Private Limted agreed to acquire H2o Dynamics India Limited from Quest Flow Controls Limited (BSE:543982) for INR 73.5 million on March 30, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 73.5 million will be paid by Stellarin Research and Development Private Limted.

For the period ending March 30, 2025, H2o Dynamics India Limited reported total revenue of INR 81.13 million. As of March 30, 2025, H2o Dynamics India Limited reported total common equity of INR 13.5 million.

The expected completion of the transaction is March 30, 2026 to May 30, 2026.
